## Tofu  

- before use, almost always want to press tofu
- press tofu by wrapping up in clean dish towel and setting something heavy on top for 15-20 minutes 

### Marinate Tofu 

- in the morning, press and cut into cubes
- put into a container with tamari and sesame oil
- let marinate for 6-8 hours 
- freezing then thawing tofu will remove additional moisture, giving the tofu a more spongy texture and will soak up more flavor 

### Saute Tofu 

- after pressing, cut into cubes 
- after pan & oil is heated, add tofu to pan
- stir until sides are lightly golden 
- add additoinal spices/salt/pepper 

### Baked Tofu 

| Servings | Time | Source |
|:-----|:---|:-------------------|
| 2-4  | 40 min | Cookie & Kate, [cookieandkate.com/how-to-make-crispy-baked-tofu](https://cookieandkate.com/how-to-make-crispy-baked-tofu/) | 

#### Ingredients:

- 1 bock tofu (16 oz, extra firm)
- 1 TBSP sesame oil or olive oil 
- 1 TBSP tamari 
- 1 TBSP cornstarch or arrowroot starch 

#### Directions 

- Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F and line a large, rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent tofu from sticking.
- If extra firm tofu, cube (otherwise press tofu for at least 10 min) 
- Put cubed tofu into mixing bowl, drizzle oil and tamari and toss to combine
- Sprinkle in the starch and toss the tofu until starch is evenly coated 
- arrange tofu on baking sheet in even layer
- bake for 25-30 minutes, tossing tofu half-way, until tofu is deeply golden on edges 
- Transfer pressed tofu to medium mixing bowl and drizzle with olive oil and tamari.  Toss to combine.  Sprinkle in the starch over the tofu, and toss the tofu
